overview_description.description:
Sketchbox is photoshop for AR and VR.

They believe that someday there will be just as many AR/VR designers as there are web and graphic designers today. So far, they’ve worked with over 2000 designers and found that the “power users” are spending an average of 3.5 hours per week on the platform. Companies like Microsoft, Oculus and Eon Reality have tested out Sketchbox. It’s a $6 billion market opportunity, Sketchbox believes.

product.name: Sketchbox VR Training & Assessment Platform
product.description: A virtual reality platform for employee training and assessment that supports remote, scalable, and interactive learning experiences.

product.name: AI Instruction Engine
product.description: An AI-driven system that personalizes training by adapting learning plans and pacing to individual student performance.

product.name: Sketchbox Insights
product.description: An analytics dashboard that provides configurable data visualization and reporting on student progress and training effectiveness.

product.name: Real-Time Collaboration System
product.description: A system enabling multiple users to participate simultaneously in VR training sessions with spatial audio and instructor controls.

product.name: No Code Scenario Builder
product.description: A tool that enables users without programming skills to create and customize VR training scenarios through a simple interface.

product.name: Device and User Management
product.description: A centralized system for managing VR devices and users, including remote installation and updates of VR applications.
